title: Obstructions to the ampleness of invariant jet differentials on complete intersections
summary: We introduce the analogue, for invariant jet differentials, of the principal symbol of a differential operator: the component of maximal degree in the highest derivative. The top symbol identifies a canonical quotient bundle of the Demailly--Semple bundle $E_{k,m}T^*_X$, with values in jet differentials of lower order, and together with the Brückmann--Rackwitz vanishing theorem it gives a non-ampleness criterion for $E_{k,m}T^*_Z$ on complete intersections $Z\subset\PP^N$.
